summary: Cloudflare R2 Integration Testing Complete - All 8 tests passed. R2 storage is working correctly for resume uploads. Files are being uploaded to R2 with proper metadata, and download endpoints return 307 redirects to time-limited signed URLs.

minor.issue: r2_metadata field was not being returned in the API response (FIXED during testing)

passed_tests: ✅ Employer login works correctly (HTTP 200, returns valid token)
✅ Admin login works correctly (HTTP 200, returns valid token)
✅ Public application resume upload stores file in R2 (r2_metadata.storage = 'r2')
✅ Candidate Bank add endpoint stores resume in R2 (r2_metadata.storage = 'r2')
✅ Resume download endpoint returns 307 redirect to R2 signed URL
✅ Signed URL actually returns the file content (verified content retrieval)
✅ JD parsing endpoint works correctly (parses title, skills, experience, location)
✅ R2 signed URLs are time-limited (600 seconds expiry)
✅ Frontend loads correctly and employer dashboard is accessible

r2_integration_verification.note: ListBuckets operation fails with AccessDenied (expected - token doesn't have that permission), but PutObject/GetObject operations work correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: r2_metadata field was not being returned in /api/jobs/{job_id}/applicants endpoint response. Added line 2595 to include r2_metadata in enriched applicant response.

mocked_apis.note: Email and SMS notifications are MOCKED

context_for_next_testing_agent: R2 integration is fully working. Files uploaded via public apply and candidate-bank/add are stored in Cloudflare R2 with proper metadata (r2_metadata.storage='r2', r2_metadata.r2_key contains the R2 object key). The /api/uploads/{filename} endpoint returns 307 redirect to R2 signed URL when redirect=true (default), or streams content directly when redirect=false. Signed URLs expire after 600 seconds. The r2_metadata field is now included in the /api/jobs/{job_id}/applicants response.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The r2_metadata field was being stored in MongoDB but not returned in the /api/jobs/{job_id}/applicants API response
reproduction_steps: 1. Upload a resume via public apply or candidate-bank/add
2. R2 metadata is stored in MongoDB (verified)
4. r2_metadata was null in response (before fix)
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Added r2_metadata field to the enriched applicant response in get_job_applicants function (line 2595)
